metadata: document_id, source, page, page_id, document_type, year, language, chunk_index, start_char, end_char_approx
hypothesis: Small chunks fit the model's token window, so retrieval is sharp; but fixed cuts can split long evidence quotes and cut mid-sentence, hurting Evidence Hit@3 and coherence for long-quote questions (q04, q08, q18).
notes: Hypothesis written before any retrieval run (2026-11-13). Results 2026-11-13: 561 chunks, ingest 1.54 s; evidence fragmented in 6/21 questions; 25/561 chunks over 128-token window; coherence 0.60, grounding 0.83.

chunking: paragraph/heading blocks per page (merged up to max)
hypothesis: Paragraph chunks keep ideas whole (better coherence, long quotes stay in one chunk), but longer chunks exceed the model's max_seq_length so the tail is not embedded; expect higher coherence, Hit@3 similar or lower than A on questions whose evidence sits late in a chunk.
notes: Only chunking differs from A (A-B comparison). Results 2026-11-13: 330 chunks, ingest 0.90 s; fragmented 2/21; 239/330 chunks over 128-token window (evidence beyond window in 4/21); coherence 1.30, grounding 1.17.

filter: document_type where question supplies it (4 questions); otherwise unfiltered
hypothesis: Filter removes the other document's near-duplicate definitions, so filter questions improve vs B with 100% filter compliance; unfiltered questions identical to B by construction.
notes: Only filter differs from B (B-C comparison). Results 2026-11-13: Same as B on 17 unfiltered questions; filter compliance 4/4 (B 2/4) but no Hit changed. Selected: rule eliminated A by chunk count; B-C tie broken by dev filter compliance (not pre-registered).
